#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

struct Flow {
    struct Edge {
        int to, rev;
        ll cap, flow, cost;
        Edge(int to, int rev, ll cap, ll cost) : to(to), rev(rev), cap(cap), flow(0), cost(cost) {}
    };

    static vector<vector<Edge>> graph;
    static int n;

    static void init(int n) {
        Flow::n = n;
        graph.assign(n, vector<Edge>());
    }

    static void addEdge(int s, int t, ll cap, ll cost) {
        graph[s].emplace_back(t, graph[t].size(), cap, cost);
        graph[t].emplace_back(s, graph[s].size() - 1, 0, -cost);
    }

    // Dinic
    static bool bfs(int s, int t, vector<int>& d) {
        fill(d.begin(), d.end(), -1);
        d[s] = 0;
        vector<int> q(n);
        int qs = 0;
        q[qs++] = s;
        for (int i = 0; i < qs; i++) {
            int u = q[i];
            for (const Edge& e : graph[u]) {
                if (d[e.to] < 0 && e.flow < e.cap) {
                    d[e.to] = d[u] + 1;
                    q[qs++] = e.to;
                }
            }
        }
        return d[t] >= 0;
    }

    static ll dfs(vector<int>& ptr, vector<int>& d, int t, int u, ll f) {
        if (u == t) return f;
        for (; ptr[u] < (int)graph[u].size(); ++ptr[u]) {
            Edge& e = graph[u][ptr[u]];
            if (d[e.to] == d[u] + 1 && e.flow < e.cap) {
                ll df = dfs(ptr, d, t, e.to, min(f, e.cap - e.flow));
                if (df > 0) {
                    e.flow += df;
                    graph[e.to][e.rev].flow -= df;
                    return df;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static ll maxFlow(int s, int t) {
        ll flow = 0;
        vector<int> d(n);
        while (bfs(s, t, d)) {
            vector<int> ptr(n, 0);
            while (true) {
                ll df = dfs(ptr, d, t, s, LLONG_MAX);
                if (df == 0) break;
                flow += df;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }

    // Min-cost flow
    static void bellmanFord(int s, vector<int>& dist, vector<int>& prevNode, vector<int>& prevEdge, vector<int>& curFlow) {
        fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), INT_MAX);
        dist[s] = 0;
        curFlow[s] = INT_MAX;
        vector<bool> inQ(n, false);
        vector<int> q(n);
        int qt = 0;
        q[qt++] = s;
        for (int qh = 0; (qh - qt) % n != 0; qh++) {
            int u = q[qh % n];
            inQ[u] = false;
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)graph[u].size(); i++) {
                Edge& e = graph[u][i];
                if (e.flow >= e.cap) continue;
                int v = e.to;
                int nd = dist[u] + e.cost;
                if (dist[v] > nd) {
                    dist[v] = nd;
                    prevNode[v] = u;
                    prevEdge[v] = i;
                    curFlow[v] = min(curFlow[u], (int)(e.cap - e.flow));
                    if (!inQ[v]) {
                        inQ[v] = true;
                        q[qt++ % n] = v;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static pair<int, int> minCostFlow(int s, int t, int maxf) {
        vector<int> dist(n);
        vector<int> curFlow(n);
        vector<int> prevEdge(n);
        vector<int> prevNode(n);
        int flow = 0, cost = 0;
        while (flow < maxf) {
            bellmanFord(s, dist, prevNode, prevEdge, curFlow);
            if (dist[t] == INT_MAX) break;
            int df = min(curFlow[t], maxf - flow);
            flow += df;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevNode[v]) {
                Edge& e = graph[prevNode[v]][prevEdge[v]];
                e.flow += df;
                graph[v][e.rev].flow -= df;
                cost += df * e.cost;
            }
        }
        return {flow, cost};
    }
};

vector<vector<Flow::Edge>> Flow::graph;
int Flow::n;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int N, M, K, C, D;
    cin >> N >> M >> K >> C >> D;

    vector<int> pos(N, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        pos[x - 1]++;
    }

    const int T = 100;
    Flow::init((T + 1) * N + 2);

    // source to initial positions
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        if (pos[i] > 0) {
            Flow::addEdge(0, i + 1, pos[i], 0);
        }
    }

    // stay edges between time layers
    for (int i = 0; i < T; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
            Flow::addEdge(1 + i * N + j, 1 + (i + 1) * N + j, K, 0);
        }
    }

    // sink edges for each time and each person
    for (int i = 0; i <= T; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= K; j++) {
            Flow::addEdge(1 + i * N, (T + 1) * N + 1, 1, C * i);
        }
    }

    // road edges
    for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
        int a, b;
        cin >> a >> b;
        a--; b--;
        for (int j = 0; j < T; j++) {
            int cost = 0;
            for (int l = 1; l <= K; l++) {
                int curCost = l * l * D - cost;
                Flow::addEdge(1 + j * N + a, 1 + (j + 1) * N + b, 1, curCost);
                Flow::addEdge(1 + j * N + b, 1 + (j + 1) * N + a, 1, curCost);
                cost = l * l * D;
            }
        }
    }

    auto res = Flow::minCostFlow(0, (T + 1) * N + 1, K);
    cerr << res.first << endl;
    cout << res.second << endl;

    return 0;
}
